fields.summary: Autonomous plan run on change set 01M61GW821FWSX05A9FC231N65. The owner was not present, so the interview question on how a message reaches a session that is busy working was raised to the arbiter. The arbiter ruled: a message to a busy session is written to its message file as today, and its pointer is returned to the agent as hook context at the next tool-call boundary (PostToolUse). The typed pointer at the prompt stays as the fallback when the session goes idle with no further tool call. No owner words were given, so no quotes.
fields.title: Message a busy session: arbiter ruling on delivery
